editorial:
You meet Adrien, a 40-year-old guy who still acts like a kid, right as Maude walks away because she wants a real family. Instead of giving up, he moves into a nursery home called The Beginning to prove he can grow up. The setup is silly, warm, and full of awkward moments, so you get a light comedy about maturity, love, and second chances. The nursery kids and staff keep the energy high, while Adrien’s mistakes make you laugh without feeling mean. It never takes itself too seriously, which helps the sweet moments land.

The acting keeps things lively, the pacing stays quick, and the jokes land often, though some scenes feel a bit predictable. You will enjoy the heart under the chaos, but a few gags repeat before the ending. It is best for viewers who want an easy, feel-good comedy night with friends or family. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Adrien finally steps up during a nursery emergency and shows Maude he can be responsible. The twist is that his messy plan actually teaches him what family means, not just how to win her back. Maude sees the change, forgives him, and they reunite with a fresh start. The last shot leaves you smiling as Adrien embraces his new grown-up role.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves light romantic comedies and family-friendly laughs.
